description: Deterministic lookup grounded in Hahn, Krief et al., 'An Evidence-Driven Analysis of Threat Information Sharing Challenges for Industrial Control Systems' (arXiv:2512.18714v3, Jan 2026). Returns whether STIX 2.1 can represent a given technique/protocol/CVE's artifacts (full/partial/none) and whether public reporting gave enough technical detail to be actionable for detection engineering. No LLM in the lookup path. Price: $0.20 USDC per call via x402 on Base mainnet. An unpaid call returns an x402 PaymentRequired challenge; retry the identical call with the signed payload in _meta["x402/payment"].

campaign.description: Optional filter: Triton, Stuxnet, or Industroyer.

cve_id.description: CVE ID from the paper's CISA KEV table, e.g. CVE-2023-3595. At least one of technique_id, protocol, or cve_id is required.

protocol.description: ICS protocol name, e.g. TriStation, S7Comm, CIP. At least one of technique_id, protocol, or cve_id is required.

technique_id.description: MITRE ATT&CK ICS technique ID, e.g. T0836. At least one of technique_id, protocol, or cve_id is required.

name: getStixCoverage
title: STIX Representability + Actionability Lookup
